enabled.description: Enable the FusionInventory agent to run and send inventory reports.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the agent log file.

server_url.description: URL of the FusionInventory server to which inventory and task responses are sent.

inventory_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic inventory runs. Set to 0 for on-demand only.

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for server connections or agent plugins before timing out.

user.description: System user account under which the agent processes run (must have sufficient privileges for inventory).

group.description: System group under which the agent processes run.

log_size.description: Maximum log file size (in MB) before rotation. Set to 0 to disable log rotation.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for communication with the FusionInventory server.

ssl_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the client certificate (PEM format) for mutual TLS authentication (required if SSL enabled).

ssl_key_path.description: Absolute path to the client private key (PEM format) corresponding to the certificate.

ssl_ca_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the CA certificate bundle used to verify the server’s certificate.

ssl_allow_self_signed.description: Allow self-signed certificates on the server (insecure; only for test environments).

extra_tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to attach to all inventory reports from this agent (e.g., 'production', 'webserver').

config.description: Plugin-specific key=value configuration parameters (varies by plugin).

plugins.description: List of active plugins and their per-plugin configuration. Available plugins: inventory, netdiscovery, network, wakeonlan, esx, etc.

pre_inventory_cmd.description: Shell command to execute before each inventory (e.g., run a backup or cleanup script).

post_inventory_cmd.description: Shell command to execute after each inventory (e.g., trigger alerting or logging).
